description: This file defines an interface 'ExceptionContextProvider' for accessing a context data structure in exceptions within the Apache Commons Math library. It includes a method to retrieve the exception context used for customizing error messages and storing key-value pairs.

classes.name: ExceptionContextProvider
classes.description: An interface for classes that provide access to an exception's context data, allowing customization of error messages and storage of additional key-value information.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns a reference to the exception context data structure for customizing error messages and storing key-value pairs.
